items.title: FTC Impersonators Are Calling — They Will Threaten to Deactivate Your Phone
items.summary:
The FTC is not calling to deactivate your phone number.

Scammers are posing as FTC officials and claiming a phone was registered under your name and used for scams in another country. They read off a fake badge ID and threaten to disconnect your phone unless you cooperate. Then they transfer you to a "police officer" who asks for your ID and personal information for a "report." Later they claim you're under arrest and need to send money for a security deposit. None of this is real.
